# Infer source origin from file path

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `metadata.source-guess.task` |
| Source | `07_tasks/metadata.source-guess.task.yaml` |
| Tags | task |

Infer a source origin label ("gemini", "openai", "perplexity",
"undermind", "manual", "scraped", "uploads", or "unknown") from
the relative path of a file. Wraps lib.metadata.extract.infer_source_guess.

### Run Operations

#### Python

_No operation description provided._

```python
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from lib.metadata.extract import infer_source_guess

source = infer_source_guess(Path("{{ rel_path }}"))
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump({"source_guess": source}, f)

```
